issue_context.title: support add foreign key constraint with auto-create index.
issue_context.body:
## Dev Task

support add foreign key constraint with auto-create index.

review_comments: Is there any error code for it in MySQL.

No, MySQL doesn't have this error. This is a slight compatibility issue with MySQL.
But the error should only happen when concurrently executing `drop index` and  `add foreign key`.
Could you add a test for creating multiple foreign keys in one statement?
